The pass is a transcription of the arcdps meter's OWN counting code, pasted into Discord by deltaconnected on 2026-08-26: stability only counts when more than one stack came off, self-consumed blind never counts, the condition dump a player takes on going down is subtracted back out, pets fold into their master, and there is no squad/non-squad discrimination anywhere. GW2EI has always emitted it (`JsonLogBuilder.cs:315`) and this project never did, and the omission was not cosmetic: an EI-shaped consumer that reads the empty set as "nothing is personal" rather than as "unclassified" filters every modifier away, which is exactly what blanked axibridge's Damage Modifiers panel for every natively parsed log (reported 2026-08-26). The classification rule is GW2EI's own and the `SpecSpecificShared` subtlety is reproduced with it: EI tests the descriptor's `Srcs`, not the source bucket the container filed the modifier under, so a `.UsingSpecSpecificShared()` modifier is offered to everyone yet counts as personal only for its own spec.
